candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to always return the zero address instead of the stored owner.
Change owner() to return the caller's address instead of the stored owner.
Replace the ownership transfer to newOwner with a transfer to the zero address, so after a call owner() is address(0) instead of newOwner.
Delete the _transferOwnership call so ownership never changes and owner() keeps its old value after transferOwnership.
Delete the zero-address check so transferOwnership(address(0)) succeeds and sets owner to the zero address instead of reverting.
Invert the owner check so only non-owners may pass the onlyOwner guard, letting an arbitrary caller change ownership so owner() differs after transferOwnership.
Delete the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can execute transferOwnership and change the owner.
